what_this_is: Every C-mode token of corpus/sentences/bank.json (HEAD 87310bda) that carries a vocab link, re-read with SudachiPy (full dictionary, split mode C) in its sentence and held against the linked record's registered forms, kana readings and part of speech. One row per link the evidence contradicts. Addressed by sentence SLUG and token POSITION, never by row id.
replay: An apply script must (1) find the token by (sentence, position) in split mode C, (2) refuse the row unless the token still carries old_vocab and its surface still equals `surface`, (3) for action relink set the token's vocab to new_vocab, for unlink clear it, for review do nothing until a ruling fills new_vocab, (4) then run scripts/ingest/build_sentence_vocab.py for the sentence edges. Sentence levels are NOT a side effect: see the report, several target records carry levels that belong to their mislinked sibling.

evidence_rules.form: lemma, Sudachi normalized form, or a lexicalised inflected surface is a registered form of the record (apply_orthographic_relinks.Registry); a 2..5-token run containing the token counts as a W12 run anchor
evidence_rules.reading: the dictionary-form reading (realized reading minus surface okurigana plus lemma okurigana) must be a registered kana reading; contradiction only when BOTH Sudachi's reading and the stored token reading miss
evidence_rules.identity: Sudachi's normalized form confirms a record that owns it (a kana normalized form confirms only a usually-kana record); the text's own kanji lemma confirms the record that owns that spelling
evidence_rules.pos: apply_orthographic_relinks.TOK2JM veto, plus Sudachi's own lexicon: a kana token whose coarse POS never occurs for the record's headword at the record's reading
evidence_rules.tie_breaks: stored reading over Sudachi-only reading; headword equal to the normalized form; scripts/export/vocab_identity.py printed-reading tier (the one record whose kana is the reading in the text)
evidence_rules.precedent: pairs already ruled by scripts/fix_homophone_vocab_links.py (刷る->為る, 九->此の, 彼 あれ->かれ, 背 せい->せ, 様 さま->よう, 最も->尤も) relink without review
